      argument: "{\"skill\":\"headwater-authoring\",\"args\":\"Write a new obligation_record (shelf docs/obligations/) recording this open obligation: the additive campaign's probes each state their task in two or three phrasings (per HW-DR-0112 and tools/probe/phrasing.sh), and campaign.sh pools/draws repetitions evenly across phrasings per probe, but nothing reports a pass rate broken out by phrasing/wording.
